class.name: IESProfile
class.brief_description: Photometric IES light distribution profile resampled into a normalized 256×64 half-float candela table.
class.description: [IESProfile] represents an ANSI/IES LM-63-1995 or LM-63-2002 photometric luminaire distribution that can be assigned to [OmniLight3D], [SpotLight3D], or [AreaLight3D] via [member Light3D.ies_profile]. On import (via [ResourceImporterIES]) or runtime loading (via [method load_from_ies_string] or [method load_from_ies_file]), the raw candela grid is symmetrically unfolded according to photometric type (Type C, B, or A) and resampled into a normalized 256×64 [constant Image.FORMAT_RH] lookup texture, while preserving the peak candela intensity in [member peak_candela]. Only [code]TILT=NONE[/code] LM-63 files are supported; files specifying [code]TILT=INCLUDE[/code] or external tilt files are rejected with an error.

method.name: get_candela_table
method.description: Returns the resampled 256×64 normalized candela table as a flat row-major [PackedFloat32Array] (16,384 floats in [code][0, 1][/code]), or an empty array if [member profile_image] is unset.

method.name: load_from_ies_file
method.description: Reads an ANSI/IES LM-63-1995 or LM-63-2002 [code].ies[/code] file from [param path] and populates this resource. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if the file specifies a non-[code]NONE[/code] [code]TILT=[/code] directive, or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] / [constant ERR_FILE_CANT_OPEN] on malformed or unreadable input.

method.name: load_from_ies_string
method.description: Parses ANSI/IES LM-63-1995 or LM-63-2002 photometric text directly from [param text], resamples it into a normalized 256×64 [constant Image.FORMAT_RH] [member profile_image], and updates [member peak_candela], [member lumens], [member watts], [member photometric_type], [member vertical_angles], and [member horizontal_angles]. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when [code]TILT=[/code] is not [code]NONE[/code].

method.name: sample
method.description: Bilinearly samples the normalized candela table for a direction vector in the light's local coordinate space (forward emission along [code]-Z[/code], right [code]+X[/code], up [code]+Y[/code]). Returns a multiplier in [code][0, 1][/code] matching the GPU IES atlas evaluation.

method.name: sample_angles
method.description: Bilinearly samples the normalized candela table at the given polar angle [param vertical_deg] (in [code][0, 180][/code] degrees from forward [code]-Z[/code]) and azimuthal angle [param horizontal_deg] (in degrees around [code]-Z[/code]).

method.name: set_candela_table
method.description: Builds and assigns [member profile_image] from a flat row-major 256×64 [PackedFloat32Array] (16,384 normalized entries clamped to [code][0, 1][/code]).

members.member: Original horizontal photometric angles (in degrees) parsed from the LM-63 source file.
Total rated luminous flux (in lumens) parsed from the LM-63 header.
Peak candela intensity (in candelas, after candela multiplier and ballast factors) used to normalize [member profile_image]. Applied when [member Light3D.ies_use_intensity] is [code]true[/code].
Photometric coordinate system declared by the LM-63 header.
Normalized 256×64 [constant Image.FORMAT_RH] candela lookup image uploaded to the GPU IES profile atlas.
Original vertical photometric angles (in degrees) parsed from the LM-63 source file.
Input power (in watts) parsed from the LM-63 header.

constants.constant: Type C photometry (vertical polar axis, standard architectural and roadway luminaires).
Type B photometry (horizontal polar axis, floodlights).
Type A photometry (automotive headlamps and signal lights).
